name: Upload
reading: Upload: 6 typestates over 6 checker nodes, lookahead 1; 7 rules (the start and one per typestate: in it each next typestate is possible and nothing else is). Faithfulness is decided as one bisimulation check: pass faithful a task or lean to compare a model with this protocol

rules.formula: (and (and (not (or (after Begin) (after Ack) (after Commit) (after Done))) #0=(not terminal)) (EX #1=(and (after Begin) #0#)) (AX (or #1#)))
rules.name: start

rules.formula: (AG (implies (and (and (not (or (after Begin) (after Ack) (after Commit) (after Done))) #0=(not terminal)) (EX #1=(and (after Begin) #0#)) (AX (or #1#))) (and (EX #2=(and #1# (EX #3=(and (after Ack) #0#)) (AX (or #3#)))) (AX (or #2#)))))
rules.name: typestate 0: (start)
rules.notation: AG (((¬(Begin ∨ Ack ∨ Commit ∨ Done) ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Begin ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (Begin ∧ ¬terminal)) → (EX ((Begin ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal)) ∧ AX ((Begin ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal))))

rules.name: typestate 1: Begin
rules.notation: AG (((Begin ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal)) → (EX ((Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Commit ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (Commit ∧ ¬terminal)) ∧ AX ((Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Commit ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (Commit ∧ ¬terminal))))

rules.name: typestate 2: Ack
rules.notation: AG (((Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Commit ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (Commit ∧ ¬terminal)) → (EX ((Commit ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal)) ∧ AX ((Commit ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal))))

rules.name: typestate 3: Commit
rules.notation: AG (((Commit ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ AX (Ack ∧ ¬terminal)) → (EX ((Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Done ∧ terminal) ∧ AX (Done ∧ terminal)) ∧ AX ((Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Done ∧ terminal) ∧ AX (Done ∧ terminal))))

rules.name: typestate 4: Ack
rules.notation: AG (((Ack ∧ ¬terminal) ∧ EX (Done ∧ terminal) ∧ AX (Done ∧ terminal)) → (EX ((Done ∧ terminal) ∧ EX (Done ∧ terminal) ∧ AX (Done ∧ terminal)) ∧ AX ((Done ∧ terminal) ∧ EX (Done ∧ terminal) ∧ AX (Done ∧ terminal))))

rules.name: typestate 5: Done (may end)
rules.notation: AG (((Done ∧ terminal) ∧ EX (Done ∧ terminal) ∧ AX (Done ∧ terminal)) → (EX ((Done ∧ terminal) ∧ EX (Done ∧ terminal) ∧ AX (Done ∧ terminal)) ∧ AX ((Done ∧ terminal) ∧ EX (Done ∧ terminal) ∧ AX (Done ∧ terminal))))
